description: Legal Affairs Department - Order made to amend the Regulation 09 of the Registered Stock and Securities  (Primary Dealers) Regulations No. 01 of 2009 Published in Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 1607/19 of 24.06.2009
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Finance under the Registered Stock and Securities Ordinance, specifically amending the Registered Stock and Securities (Primary Dealers) Regulations.
